sourceName: Viettel Money - So sánh lãi suất vay
notes: Comparison table lists a single unsecured (vay tín chấp) figure of 24%/năm for HDBank, no date, no basis, no amount or term. Read as a ceiling (single figure), so min left null. The existing official research already holds an HDBank blog (26/02/2025) saying unsecured packages run 13%-24%/năm; I could not re-read that page this session (fetch returned only the page shell), so the 13% floor is not repeated here. topi.vn (dated 03/11/2026) lists only a secured consumer loan at 8%/năm for HDBank, which is not comparable. News pages dated 2026 about HDBank rate cuts are corporate/SME or average-rate items, not this product.

No secondary source with a current rate found. Vietnamese searches returned only HDBank's own 2024 product sheet and promotion T&C, which the existing official research already uses (1.5% and 1.7%/tháng flat). A search summary of those sheets also mentions amount 5-100 triệu and terms 6/12/24/36 months, but I did not fetch them in this task. No aggregator or press page gave a rate for this product.

sourceName: Viettel Money - So sánh lãi suất vay
notes: Lender-wide unsecured range, undated, no basis. The same 12,5%-20% appears in MB's own blog 'Vay tín chấp là gì?' (26/03/2026, already in the existing research) and the endpoints match a September 2023 press article (12,5% public-sector staff, 20% fast drawdown), so the figure may be recycled rather than current. Disagreeing sources: topi.vn (02/11/2026) says only 'lãi vay thông thường dao động từ 9-12%/năm' (product not named) and lists a secured loan at 7,9%/năm; the tapchicongthuong article (15/09/2023) gives no unsecured rate. Chose 12,5-20 because it has the higher maximum and matches MB's own wording. Not product-specific: MB's app product page publishes no rate.

sourceName: Viettel Money - So sánh lãi suất vay
notes: SUSPICIOUS / LIKELY STALE: the same 9,6%/năm (=0,8%/tháng, 'chỉ từ') appears on a finhay.com.vn article published 13/07/2019, so the Viettel Money figure is probably recycled from years ago. It is a 'from' figure for Sacombank salary loans in general, not specific to the online SACOMBANK PAY product, and no maximum is given. Other undated search snippets (not fetched): 8,5%/năm for vay tiêu dùng từ lương and 11%/năm for state employees (accgroup.vn), 8,99% minimum. Treat as a floor of doubtful age, not a usable range.

sourceName: Viettel Money - So sánh lãi suất vay
notes: Same caveats as the online salary loan: undated, no basis, no maximum, and the identical 9,6%/năm ('chỉ từ 9,6%/năm tương đương 0,8%/tháng') is on a finhay.com.vn page dated 13/07/2019, so probably stale. Sacombank's official base-rate table (already in existing research) shows a medium/long-term base of 10,0%, which is ABOVE this figure, another sign 9,6% is outdated. A vneconomy article on 'tối đa 500 triệu' for Sacombank unsecured consumer loans has no rate and an inconsistent date (2009/2021); not used.

No current secondary rate found. The only secondary rate found is 'lãi suất góp đều là 0,84%/tháng' on diendandoanhnghiep.vn and thitruongtaichinhtiente.vn, both dated 29/07/2019 (amount 6-100 triệu, terms 6/12/24 months, up to 90% of card limit). It is seven years old and far below Sacombank's current official sheets (1,2-1,5%/tháng), so it is deliberately NOT used. Official figures already exist in the lender file (from 1%/tháng; 1,2-1,5%/tháng).

sourceName: Viettel Money - So sánh lãi suất vay
notes: Lender-wide unsecured range, undated, no basis stated on this page. Conflicts: Techcombank's own blog techcombank.com/thong-tin/blog/lai-suat-vay-tin-chap (page metadata 04/11/2026) says 'chỉ từ 12.9%/năm ... dư nợ giảm dần', amount up to 1,000,000,000 VND, term 12-60 months (this is the official floor, already in the existing research; it gives no Techcombank maximum, and its 12.9-18% is a market-wide range). finhay.com.vn (13/07/2019) says 16%/năm; doanhnghiephoinhap.vn (16/05/2023) says 7,49-9,49%, plainly outdated. Chose 13,78-16,00 for having a stated max, but its minimum (13,78) is HIGHER than the official 12.9 floor, so the true low end is 12.9 on reducing balance. The basis 'reducing' is stated only by the Techcombank blog, not by Viettel Money.
